answer: Time-locked staking resists Sybil attacks by freezing each new identity's capital for 20 epochs. Admission locks a 500-unit stake; honest work releases 5% per epoch, while proven duplication slashes 60% and resets the timer. The lock is no haven for rented funds: an attacker building an island of 100 clones must lock 50,000 units with zero turnover, each clone balanced on a ledge of slashing risk until release.
